purpose: Honest residual list for the run-failclosed meta-gate. A green instrumented surface is not a clean bill of health while OPEN or UNENUMERATED rows remain.

stdlib_should_fail_closed.covers: empty/domain/type/non-collection matrix in NON_COLLECTION_SURFACE.md + prior 27-site land

doc_ok_ieee.covers: float /0 → inf, sqrt(neg) → NaN — MUST stay PASS

permanent_controls.covers: div0 int, index OOB, happy clamp, side-effect write

enforcement.covers: taint→shell refuse at run; int div0

doc_ok_excluded_from_failclosed_claim.note: int/float/parse_* → 0; LANGUAGE documented; parse_*_opt is fail-closed escape
upper/split/replace/starts_with on non-strings via display_string; language-wide

open_named_residuals.summary: Check-path FA class (historical ~22 / ~17 CRITICAL). Run preflight trusts typecheck_ex — FA at check is FA at run.
settling_evidence: Each FA witness: DIRECT form reject + LAUNDERED form reject after fix
Security fixture suite green with FA class closed (not merely 219/219 while reds remain elsewhere)
Walker/single-path design evidence class cannot recur (HORUS matrix + rehunt)
Sealed command logs under implementer/ or fleet scratchpad

open_named_residuals.summary: Missing struct/map field read often yields Int(0) in dynamic record paths — design residue, not in 45 corpus.
settling_evidence: Patch + fixtures OR explicit language design note that dynamic fields invent 0

open_named_residuals.summary: take/drop/substr use .max(0) on negative counts/indices — Python-like soft clamp, not in fail-closed corpus.
settling_evidence: Patch to ANUBIS_INVALID_ARGUMENT + fixtures OR DOC_OK row + product acceptance

unenumerated_surfaces.summary: Builtins are ~213 by five-function union in run.rs. NON_COLLECTION_SURFACE.md covers the collection/string/map first-arg class systematically; it does NOT enumerate every builtin domain/IO/coercion edge.
unenumerated_surfaces.risk: Another SEKHMET-style hole can exist outside the matrix (e.g. I/O, crypto edge, typed coercion) until an explicit full-builtin audit is finished.

unenumerated_surfaces.summary: read_file missing path, write permission, etc. — not in should_fail_closed corpus as a systematic matrix.
unenumerated_surfaces.risk: Silent empty string / invent vs panic not fully instrumented.

unenumerated_surfaces.summary: is_non_run_builtin (shell/symbolic/…) — intentional non-run; check≠run by design.
unenumerated_surfaces.risk: Product residual, not silent-wrong value — must stay named in docs.

unenumerated_surfaces.summary: ANUBIS_RUN_RESEARCH_REQUIRES_ALLOW — correct mode gate, not a fail-closed hole.

stamp_rules.PASS_INSTRUMENTED: All instrumented fail-closed + doc_ok + control + enforcement buckets green. Means: the surfaces we chose to look at are green. Does NOT mean run is fail-closed as a whole.
stamp_rules.PASS_RUNTIME_FAILCLOSED_WHOLE: PASS_INSTRUMENTED AND open_named_residuals with severity BLOCKS_WHOLE_CLAIM are all CLOSED with settling evidence AND product accepts DOC_OK exclusions AND unenumerated_surfaces are either enumerated+tested or explicitly accepted as residual.
